profile.headline: Founder & AI Architect, EduLogicsAI | Building Edutica™ | Applied AI, Multi-Agent Systems & Intelligent Learning Platforms
profile.summary:
Im a software and AI architect with a passion for building intelligent systems that solve real-world problems.

Over the years, my work has focused on software architecture, distributed systems, cloud platforms, and increasingly, applied AI and multi-agent systems.

Today, Im building EduLogicsAI, an AI technology company focused on making personalized, adaptive learning more practical and accessible.

Our first product is Edutica™, starting with MCAT® Prep.

The idea is simple: students shouldn't have to constantly figure out what to study next, which weaknesses matter most, or how to adjust their preparation when their performance changes.

Edutica is being built to connect study plans, guided learning, practice questions, assessments, and progress into one continuous learning experience—one that adapts as students learn.

We're preparing for our first external student pilot, where real feedback will help shape what comes next.

I'm especially interested in connecting with educators, pre-med students, AI builders, and others who believe technology can make learning more effective.

EduLogicsAI: https://edulogicsai.com
Edutica™: https://edutica.ai

positions.title: Founder & AI Architect
positions.description:
Founded EduLogicsAI and independently architected and engineered a production-deployed AI learning platform powering Edutica™, beginning with personalized MCAT® preparation.

As Founder & AI Architect, I lead product strategy, platform architecture, AI engineering, infrastructure, and operations.

• AI Platform Architecture: Designed a modular, domain-agnostic platform supporting multiple education products through reusable AI orchestration, evaluation, content governance, and adaptive learning capabilities.
• Applied AI & Multi-Agent Systems: Architected specialized AI agents using LangGraph, LiteLLM, RAG, and governed execution for personalized learning, tutoring, practice, evaluation, and decision-making.
• Full-Stack & Cloud Engineering: Built and deployed a Next.js/React/TypeScript frontend and Python/FastAPI backend with CI/CD across Vercel, Railway, and Supabase.
• Data Architecture & Security: Implemented PostgreSQL, pgvector, row-level security, caching, and governed content lifecycle management.
• AI Quality & Observability: Developed multidimensional LLM evaluation, automated quality checks, and observability using Langfuse, Prometheus, and Grafana.
• AI Content Engineering: Built a governed research and content-generation pipeline with provenance tracking, evaluation, and publication controls.

Current focus: Preparing Edutica MCAT Prep for its first external student pilot, validating the learning experience through student feedback, and building a sustainable education technology business.

EduLogicsAI: https://edulogicsai.com
Edutica: https://edutica.ai

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
AI engineering, enterprise architecture, platform framework strategy, API governance, and agentic delivery transformation. 
• Platform Framework Strategy: Architected foundational PPDM platform capabilities improving engineering consistency, maintainability, scalability, developer productivity, and delivery velocity across multiple product teams. 
• Reactive Platform Stack: Designed and built a foundational reactive platform stack - Common Reactive Service Framework, Reactive Data Access Layer (DAL), Model Validation Framework, and Query Validation Framework. 
• API & Data Model Governance: Served on the API & Data Model Design Committee governing new and updated APIs, data contracts, standards compliance, versioning, interoperability, backward compatibility, and developer ergonomics. 
• Distributed Systems Architecture: Led architecture decisions for complex distributed systems, balancing long-term extensibility, reliability, security, operational maintainability, and accelerated delivery. 
• Agentic AI Delivery Transformation: Elevated agentic AI engineering to a first-class delivery model by championing Devin, Windsurf (Cascade), GitHub Copilot, and emerging coding assistants for measurable improvements in delivery speed and quality. 
• Specification-Driven Development Leadership: Served as frontier technical lead for Spec Driven Development (SDD) initiatives in partnership with ISG AI Governance, bridging enterprise AI governance with practical engineering execution. 
• Engineering Velocity & Quality: Reduced development cycle time and defect rates through reusable platform components, architecture standardization, AI-augmented workflows, and repeatable engineering patterns.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer | Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Cloud-native platform services, core product capabilities, and data protection modernization. 
• Architecture Governance: Contributed to the architecture and design committee for PPDM infrastructure supporting both onpremises and in-cloud deployments. 
• Core Business Services & API Design: Led API design and development for PPDM Core Common Business Services (CBS), Common Resource Service (CRS), Data Access Layer (DAL), Inventory, and Catalog microservices. 
• Metadata Management Services: Designed and developed PPDM Inventory and Catalog services providing asset, data source, data target, and backup-copy metadata management capabilities. 
• Microservices Delivery: Delivered Spring Boot and Dockerized microservices from service bootstrap and codebase creation through CI/CD with Jenkins and Kubernetes-based deployment. 
• CI/CD & Infrastructure Tooling: Built CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and managed binaries and build artifacts with JFrog Artifactory, supporting Kubernetes-based microservices deployment. 
• Legacy Migration Tooling: Led design and development of Path-To-Power migration tooling to move backup workloads from heritage Avamar products into PPDM. 
• Enterprise Data Protection Architecture: Applied distributed systems, reactive programming, REST API design, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, Kubernetes, Istio, Azure, and AWS to support enterprise-grade data protection workloads.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer | Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Security architecture and product modernization for backup and recovery platforms. 
• CAC Authentication Architecture: Led architecture and design of Common Access Card (CAC) two-factor authentication capabilities for Avamar Backup and Restore products. 
• PKI Integration: Delivered CAC integration with DoD and DoS PKI infrastructure, including certificate chain generation and validation against certificate validators such as Axway Responder. 
• Technical Point of Contact: Acted as first technical point of contact for integration efforts connecting CAC-enabled Avamar with DoD/DoS PKI backend infrastructure. 
• SaaS Architecture Evolution: Led architecture of self-contained services supporting the evolution from appliance-based solutions toward SaaS-oriented service architecture
positions.insights: Skills: Microservices · Platform Engineering · GitHub · Engineering Leadership · Enterprise Architecture · Git, GitHub, feature branches, atomic commits, fast-forward integration, parallel-agent development · Developer Productivity · Python (Programming Language) · Atlassian Jira

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Appliance lifecycle automation and enterprise modernization. 
• Appliance Lifecycle Management: Led design and development of Install and Upgrade Appliance Management for Avamar Backup and Restore products. 
• Package Applicability & Cycle-Time Reduction: Designed Package Applicability capabilities improving appliance update processing from approximately 28 hours to approximately 4 hours on average - an ~85% cycle-time improvement. 
• Enterprise-Scale Automation: Designed CLI and API capabilities enabling backend install/update automation for large enterprise customers operating thousands of systems, including 2,000+ server environments. 
• Patent Contributions: Contributed multiple patent submissions focused on enterprise software and platform innovation.
positions.insights: Skills: Microservices · Platform Engineering · Systems Design · GitHub · Engineering Leadership · Enterprise Architecture · Git, GitHub, feature branches, atomic commits, fast-forward integration, parallel-agent development · Software Architecture · Developer Productivity · Atlassian Jira · Confluence

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Mission-critical defense, transportation, SOA, performance, and secure distributed systems. 
• Defense-Grade Communication Frameworks: Designed and implemented defense-grade Ship Maintenance Server Framework capabilities responsible for HTTP, UDP, and TCP/socket communication channels for JPALS-related Navy shipboard landing systems. 
• Secure, From-Scratch DoD Software: Built secure DoD software from scratch without reliance on third-party frameworks, emphasizing formal verification, traceability, customer witness reviews, and system integration discipline. 
• Enterprise Transportation Prototyping: Proposed and prototyped Spring/Hibernate frameworks for enterprise transportation systems, and led load-simulation capabilities for high-traffic and stress testing
positions.insights: Skills: Systems Design · Engineering Leadership · Software Architecture · Developer Productivity

positions.title: Part-Time Faculty
positions.description: Enterprise Application Programming Instruction: Taught Enterprise Application Programming - EJB 3.0, JPA, Spring, Hibernate, and enterprise software design principles - to upper-level Computer Science students while working full-time at Raytheon.
positions.insights: Skills: Systems Design · Engineering Leadership · Enterprise Architecture · Software Architecture

positions.title: Senior Systems Architect | Team Lead | Java Application Developer
positions.description:
Financial transaction platforms, wire transfer systems, and secure enterprise integration for a national mortgage lender. 
• Mission-Critical Wire Transfer System: Led development of the mission-critical Instantaneous Wire (iWire) system with 99.99% availability requirements. 
• Enterprise Financial Integration: Architected secure wire transfer and integration capabilities across loan origination, PeopleSoft Cash Management, treasury systems, and external trading partners, using SWIFT formats, SSL, encryption, and digital signatures.

positions.title: Java Application Developer / Integration Engineer
positions.description:
Enterprise software, legal technology, B2B systems, scientific applications, messaging, and integration platforms. 
• Enterprise Integration & Messaging: Delivered enterprise integration interfaces, event-driven JMS processing modules, messagedriven systems, B2B platforms, and scientific desktop applications across Java, EJB, JMS, WebLogic, Oracle, MySQL, Swing, sockets, XML, and web services
